name: NoVikingLeftBehind
author: Nosferatu
description: The ultimate Valheim quality-of-life mod! 41 modules, one install: overkill tools, workbench reach, cheaper building, lighter loads, repair-all, catch-up mechanics, extra slots, loadouts, chest crafting & more. Every setting is live on the server, and the in-game settings tab now opens on a plain-language Simple view of the settings most groups change.
